squad_status_reason: picks read for GW2 while projecting GW3
team_state_reason: selling prices reconstructed exactly and bank is known
projection_regime_reason: measured this run: ep_next is identical to FPL's own backward-looking `form` for 92% of the 366 players eligible for the blend, so it is a recent-points average carrying no fixture adjustment and no team news rather than a one-week forecast

next_gw_xp.measures: expected FPL points in the projected gameweek alone

horizon_xp.measures: expected FPL points summed across the projection horizon. Beyond the first gameweek this is Gaffer's component model alone and is materially weaker than its one-week figure

solver_value.measures: what the optimiser maximises. The squad AND the starting XI are selected on this, not on the one-week figure: choosing the XI on one week was measured across three seasons and lost on the held-out one (backtest.XI_SELECTION_REFUSED)
